title: modtest
description: a simple mod that adds a few things to the game
body:
a test project
--------------------
blocks:
- gunpowder generator: made using a creeper head, generates 1 gunpowder every 20 seconds as a one-block machine.
- auto miner: a block that can mine up to 320 blocks in the direction it faces. it currently only collects the blocks filtered with a tag, and can read only one tag. (for example, "minecraft:iron_ores" if you want to mine iron)

no other features as of 1.1.1
a lot i want to add when im not lazy
